title: Install Generator- FCI Bastrop
description: Amendment 0001- Correct Set Aside error in the Instruction to Offerors Solicitation The Federal Bureau of Prisons (FBOP) is issuing solicitation 15BBNF27Q50100001 for the award of a firm-fixed-price construction contract for a project entitled Install Generator at the Federal Correctional Institution (FCI Bastrop), located in Bastrop, TX. FCI Bastrop is a federal correctional facility located at 1341 Highway 95 North, Bastrop, TX, 78602. The project consists of the following: replace the existing 750 KW Generator, load bank, and 3-way Main Switchgear and install one (1) new 2000 KW Diesel Generator and Switchgear system. See the Statement of Work/Specifications attachment included with the solicitation posting for the complete requirements of the work. The performance period for the project will be 420 Calendar Days from issuance of the notice to proceed. The NAICS code for this requirement is 238210 with a corresponding small business size standard of $19 million. The solicitation will be distributed solely through the Contract Opportunity website at https://www.sam.gov. Hard copies of the solicitation will not be made available. The website provides download instructions. The "Sensitive /Secure package Upload" option will be selected for this procurement. All secure/locked documents uploaded, to include the solicitation, will require an active SAM vendor registration to obtain access. In addition, only those vendors who have been issued a valid Marketing Partner Identification Number (MPIN) from www.sam.gov will be granted access. If your firm does not have the NAICS code listed in www.sam.gov required for this solicitation, an email may be forwarded to your firm requesting an explanation as to why your firm should be granted access. If you encounter problems accessing these documents, please contact the Federal Service Desk at 866-606-8220. All future information about this solicitation, including any amendments, will also be distributed solely through this website. Interested parties are responsible for continuously monitoring this website to ensure that they have the most recent information about this proposed contract action. IMPORTANT: Any contractor interested in obtaining a contract award with the Federal Bureau of Prisons must be registered in https://www.sam.gov. In order to qualify for award, your business size metrics information entered in your www.sam.gov SAM registration must be less than or equal to the size standard specified above. Each bidder's www.sam.gov registration will be reviewed by the Government to confirm that your business size meets the small business size standard requirement. All bidders are urged to double check their www.sam.gov registration and update as necessary, including the size metrics information. This is a 100 percent small business set-aside. You must be registered in www.sam.gov as a small business for the applicable NAICS code (see FAR provision 52.219-1 in the Representations & Certifications section of your www.sam.gov registration).

title: ND OMAD 2025(1) Minuteman Missile Access Road
description: PROJECT DESCRIPTION: The Office of Missile Air Defense Program (OMAD) is a Defense Access Road (DAR) program used by the Department of Defense (DoD) to fund the annual maintenance and improvements on certified gravel roads. FHWA works with the Military Surface Deployment and Distribution Command (SDDC) to support the Air Force Intercontinental Ballistic Missile Program (Minuteman). These Minuteman Missile Access Roads are located in 6 counties within North Dakota. SCOPE OF THE WORK: The work includes roadway reconditioning and adding four inches of aggregate surface course as well as the replacement of culverts. All proposed work is to stay on the existing roadway bench. The proposed typical section consists of reconditioning the existing gravel roadway per Section 303 and adding an additional 4-inches of Aggregate Surface Course with a maximum width of 24-feet. A 4% crown is proposed or as approved by the CO. The Contractor will need to taper down the proposed aggregate surface, per the typical section, at applicable locations.

title: Biomedical Research Application Evaluation and Support (BRAES)
description: This is a Request for Proposal (RFP) for Biomedical Research Application Evaluation and Support (BRAES) on behalf of the Congressionally Directed Medical Research Programs (CDMRP) within the Defense Health Agency (DHA) located in Frederick, MD at Fort Detrick. This requirement is a performance-based non-commercial, non-personal services support requirement and will be awarded as a Multiple Award Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quality (MA-IDIQ) contract. The CDMRP requires BRAES is for: 1) Funding opportunity announcement set-up within CDMRP electronic Biomedical Research Application Portal (eBRAP) (eBRAP task order awarded to a single vendor); 2) Oversight of electronic receipt and processing of intramural and extramural pre- and full research applications in eBRAP (eBRAP task order awarded to a single vendor); 3) Application compliance review in eBRAP (eBRAP task order awarded to a single vendor); and 4) Scientific merit peer review including operation of a secure Contractor-owned, Contractor-operated web-based electronic system which supports all activities and capabilities specific to peer review (i.e. Scientific Administration and Management/SAM) (SAM task orders awarded to multiple vendors). NOTE: The task orders associated with scientific peer review will be competed as fair opportunity between the successful BRAES Contract holders AFTER award of this MA IDIQ.

description: Amendment 3 (11/09/2026): ISO updates to Part II - Technical Areas & Requirements: TA1: Edits to the "Target" language for the Retrospective Data Access metric. Amendment 2 (10/29/2026): Numerous changes including, but not limited to,: ISO updates in Parts I, II, III and VI; TA1 clarifications; TA2 updates; TA4 updates; Q&A link added Provides Attachment B1 for TA4 Proposal Requirements and Proposal Volume Templates. Provides Attachment A2 for TA1 Solution Summary Requirements and Attachment A3 for TA2 Solution Summary Requirements. Amendment 1 (10/14/2026): Update due dates and/or times of all TAs SPECTRA will identify and act on autism trajectories, the evolving developmental paths individuals follow across the lifespan from the prenatal period through aging, spanning autism characteristics, co-occurring conditions, and functional outcomes together with the genetic, biological, behavioral, iatrogenic (medical influences), environmental factors and their nonlinear interactions. Rather than examining these factors in isolation, SPECTRA will examine how they combine and interact, including their nonlinear interactions, to produce autism and its co-occurring conditions over time. SPECTRA will also develop technologies that serve two purposes at once: extending reliable assessment beyond the clinic while improving everyday communication, function, and quality of life. The same tools people use to live more fully will also generate the data that drive measurement and personalized care.

title: ND OMAD 2025(1) Minuteman Missile Access Road
description: PROJECT DESCRIPTION: The Office of Missile Air Defense Program (OMAD) is a Defense Access Road (DAR) program used by the Department of Defense (DoD) to fund the annual maintenance and improvements on certified gravel roads. FHWA works with the Military Surface Deployment and Distribution Command (SDDC) to support the Air Force Intercontinental Ballistic Missile Program (Minuteman). SCOPE OF THE WORK: The work includes roadway reconditioning and adding four inches of aggregate surface course as well as the replacement of culverts. The proposed typical section consists of reconditioning the existing gravel roadway per Section 303 and adding an additional 4-inches of Aggregate Surface Course with a maximum width of 24-feet. A 4% crown is proposed or as approved by the CO. The Contractor will need to taper down the proposed aggregate surface, per the typical section, at applicable locations.

title: Systems for Phenotypic Evaluation, Clinical Trajectories, Response, and Agency (SPECTRA)
description: Amendment 2 (10/29/2026): Numerous changes including, but not limited to,: ISO updates in Parts I, II, III and VI; TA1 clarifications; TA2 updates; TA4 updates; Q&A link added Provides Attachment B1 for TA4 Proposal Requirements and Proposal Volume Templates. Provides Attachment A2 for TA1 Solution Summary Requirements and Attachment A3 for TA2 Solution Summary Requirements. Amendment 1 (10/14/2026): Update due dates and/or times of all TAs SPECTRA will identify and act on autism trajectories, the evolving developmental paths individuals follow across the lifespan from the prenatal period through aging, spanning autism characteristics, co-occurring conditions, and functional outcomes together with the genetic, biological, behavioral, iatrogenic (medical influences), environmental factors and their nonlinear interactions. Rather than examining these factors in isolation, SPECTRA will examine how they combine and interact, including their nonlinear interactions, to produce autism and its co-occurring conditions over time. SPECTRA will also develop technologies that serve two purposes at once: extending reliable assessment beyond the clinic while improving everyday communication, function, and quality of life. The same tools people use to live more fully will also generate the data that drive measurement and personalized care.

title: Systems for Phenotypic Evaluation, Clinical Trajectories, Response, and Agency (SPECTRA)
description: Amendment 3 (11/09/2026): ISO updates to Part II - Technical Areas & Requirements: TA1: Edit to the "Target" language for the Retrospective Data Access metric. Amendment 2 (10/29/2026): Numerous changes including, but not limited to,: ISO updates in Parts I, II, III and VI; TA1 clarifications; TA2 updates; TA4 updates; Q&A link added Provides Attachment B1 for TA4 Proposal Requirements and Proposal Volume Templates. Provides Attachment A2 for TA1 Solution Summary Requirements and Attachment A3 for TA2 Solution Summary Requirements. Amendment 1 (10/14/2026): Update due dates and/or times of all TAs SPECTRA will identify and act on autism trajectories, the evolving developmental paths individuals follow across the lifespan from the prenatal period through aging, spanning autism characteristics, co-occurring conditions, and functional outcomes together with the genetic, biological, behavioral, iatrogenic (medical influences), environmental factors and their nonlinear interactions. Rather than examining these factors in isolation, SPECTRA will examine how they combine and interact, including their nonlinear interactions, to produce autism and its co-occurring conditions over time. SPECTRA will also develop technologies that serve two purposes at once: extending reliable assessment beyond the clinic while improving everyday communication, function, and quality of life. The same tools people use to live more fully will also generate the data that drive measurement and personalized care.

title: ND OMAD 2025(1) Minuteman Missile Access Road
description: PROJECT DESCRIPTION: The Office of Missile Air Defense Program (OMAD) is a Defense Access Road (DAR) program used by the Department of Defense (DoD) to fund the annual maintenance and improvements on certified gravel roads. FHWA works with the Military Surface Deployment and Distribution Command (SDDC) to support the Air Force Intercontinental Ballistic Missile Program (Minuteman). These Minuteman Missile Access Roads are located in 6 counties within North Dakota. SCOPE OF THE WORK: The work includes roadway reconditioning and adding four inches of aggregate surface course as well as the replacement of culverts. All proposed work is to stay on the existing roadway bench. The proposed typical section consists of reconditioning the existing gravel roadway per Section 303 and adding an additional 4-inches of Aggregate Surface Course with a maximum width of 24-feet. A 4% crown is proposed or as approved by the CO. The Contractor will need to taper down the proposed aggregate surface, per the typical section, at applicable locations.

title: Field of Testing
description: The Defense Health Agency Contracting Activity (DHACA) in Fort Detrick, MD intends to negotiate on a sole source basis (IAW RFO 12.102(a)) with American Industrial Hygiene Association (AIHA), 3120 Fairview Park Dr Suite 360, Falls Church, VA 22042, as the only responsible source that can provide AIHA Lab Accreditation. This is a pre-solicitation notice in accordance with RFO 5.101. The laboratory is required to participate in the AIHA PAT Programs in every Field of Testing (FoT) accredited by AIHA LAP, LLC. The contractor shall provide the appropriate Proficiency Analytical Testing (PAT) rounds to meet minimum requirements per AIHA LAP, LLC accreditation in order to be compliant in every Field of Testing (FoT). AIHA LAP, LLC is the only entity that can provide services that will meet the requirement of Proficiency Analytical Testing (PAT) Program participation. This cquisition is being conducted under simplified acquisition procedures. There are no set-aside restrictions for this requirement. The intended procurement will be classified under North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) 334516 with a Small Business Size Standard of 500 or fewer employees. This pre-solicitation notice is not a request for competitive proposals and no solicitation document exists for this requirement. However, any parties interested in responding to this notice shall submit technical data, including cost, sufficient to determine capability in providing the same service. All capability statements received by closing of this notification of this synopsis will be considered by the Government. A determination by the Government not to compete based on responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. Information received will normally be considered solely for the purpose of determining whether to conduct competitive procurement. Based on the above information, the only technically acceptable subscription can be provided by AIHA. Submit email capability statements (using PDF, MS Word, Excel attachments) to Brian Miller at brian.d.miller1.civ@health.mil. Statements are due no later than 3:00 PM ET, 2 December 2026. No phone calls will be accepted.

title: CO OMAD 300(71) Minuteman Missile Access
description: PROJECT DESCRIPTION: The Office of Missile Air Defense Program (OMAD) is a Defense Access Road (DAR) program used by the Department of Defense (DoD) to fund the annual maintenance and improvements on certified gravel roads. FHWA works with the Military Surface Deployment and Distribution Command (SDDC) to support the Air Force Intercontinental Ballistic Missile Program (Minuteman). These Minuteman Missile Access Roads are located in southwestern Wyoming, southeastern Nebraska, and northeastern Colorado. SCOPE OF THE WORK: The work includes roadway reconditioning and adding four inches of aggregate surface course as well as the replacement of culverts. All proposed work is to stay on the existing roadway bench. The proposed typical section consists of reconditioning the existing gravel roadway per Section 303 and adding an additional 4-inches of Aggregate Surface Course with a maximum width of 24-feet. A 4% crown is proposed or as approved by the CO. The Contractor will need to taper down the proposed aggregate surface, per the typical section, at applicable locations.

title: CO OMAD 300(71) Minuteman Missile Access
description: PROJECT DESCRIPTION: The Office of Missile Air Defense Program (OMAD) is a Defense Access Road (DAR) program used by the Department of Defense (DoD) to fund the annual maintenance and improvements on certified gravel roads. FHWA works with the Military Surface Deployment and Distribution Command (SDDC) to support the Air Force Intercontinental Ballistic Missile Program (Minuteman). These Minuteman Missile Access Roads are located in southwestern Wyoming, southeastern Nebraska, and northeastern Colorado. SCOPE OF THE WORK: The work includes roadway reconditioning and adding four inches of aggregate surface course as well as the replacement of culverts. All proposed work is to stay on the existing roadway bench. The proposed typical section consists of reconditioning the existing gravel roadway per Section 303 and adding an additional 4-inches of Aggregate Surface Course with a maximum width of 24-feet. A 4% crown is proposed or as approved by the CO. The Contractor will need to taper down the proposed aggregate surface, per the typical section, at applicable locations.

title: Announcement for Partnership Proposals: Atmospheric Exploration Observatory
description: NASA�s Science Mission Directorate (SMD), Earth Science Division (ESD), is inviting innovative partnership proposals for the Atmospheric Exploration Observatory to explore collaborative opportunities for hardware utilization. NASA is exploring partnerships with external organizations to enable more impactful exploitation of NASA resources and to advance the commercial remote sensing industry. This Announcement for Partnership Proposals (AFPP) invites proposals for innovative partnerships for atmospheric exploration. This AFPP envisions one or more partnerships to complete the former GeoCarb instrument, integrate the instrument with a spacecraft, launch, operate, and share its unique data with clear benefits to the selected partner(s). title: CO OMAD 300(71) Minuteman Missile Access
description: PROJECT DESCRIPTION: The Office of Missile Air Defense Program (OMAD) is a Defense Access Road (DAR) program used by the Department of Defense (DoD) to fund the annual maintenance and improvements on certified gravel roads. FHWA works with the Military Surface Deployment and Distribution Command (SDDC) to support the Air Force Intercontinental Ballistic Missile Program (Minuteman). These Minuteman Missile Access Roads are located in southwestern Wyoming, southeastern Nebraska, and northeastern Colorado. SCOPE OF THE WORK: The work includes roadway reconditioning and adding four inches of aggregate surface course as well as the replacement of culverts. All proposed work is to stay on the existing roadway bench. The proposed typical section consists of reconditioning the existing gravel roadway per Section 303 and adding an additional 4-inches of Aggregate Surface Course with a maximum width of 24-feet. A 4% crown is proposed or as approved by the CO. The Contractor will need to taper down the proposed aggregate surface, per the typical section, at applicable locations.

title: Kauniaisten keskusta-alueen vision laatiminen
description: Hankinnan kohteena on Kauniaisten keskusta-alueen vision laatiminen tarjouspyynnön ja sen liitteenä olevan alustavantyöohjelman mukaisesti. Hankinta sisältää keskusta-alueen vision laatimisen, tarvittavan suunnittelu- ja asiantuntijatyön, vuorovaikutuksen suunnittelun ja toteuttamisen sekä alustavassa työohjelmassa määriteltyjen aineistojen tuottamisen. Työn tavoitteena on muodostaa Kauniaisten keskusta-alueen kehittämiselle noin vuoteen 2050 ulottuva yhteinen tavoitetila. Työnsisältö, työvaiheet ja tuotettavat aineistot on kuvattu tarkemmin tarjouspyynnön liitteenä olevassa alustavassa työohjelmassa. Hankintaan valitaan yksi (1) toimittaja, jonka kanssa tehdään hankintasopimus. Tarjousten valintaperusteena on kokonaistaloudellisesti edullisin tarjous. Kokonaistaloudellisen edullisuuden vertailuperusteina käytetään hintaa (30 %) ja laatua (70 %). Tarjousten pisteytys sekä laadun arviointiperusteet on kuvattu tarkemmin tarjouspyynnössä. Työn arvioitu aloitusajankohta on tammikuu 2027. Sopimuskausi alkaa hankintasopimuksen allekirjoittamisesta ja on voimassa siihen saakka, kunnes toimeksianto on kokonaisuudessaan hyväksytysti toteutettu ja sopimukseen kuuluvat tehtävät onsuoritettu. Tavoitteena on saattaa keskusta-alueen visiotyö valtuustokäsittelyyn vuoden 2028 alussa. Tarjoajan tulee tarjota koko palvelukokonaisuus. Osatarjouksia ei hyväksytä. Hankinnan kokonaisarvon ei arvioida ylittävän hankintalain tarkoittamaa kansallista kynnysarvoa, vaan hankinta on pienhankintana toteutettava palveluhankinta. Hankinta-asiakirjat ovat saatavina täydellisinä ja veloituksetta Cloudian Tarjouspalvelu-toimittajaportaalissa. Mahdolliset hankintaan liittyvät tarkentavat kysymykset tulee lähettää Cloudian Tarjouspalvelu-toimittajaportaalista 15.11.2026 klo 23:59 mennessä. Esitetyistä kysymyksistä ja niihin annetuista vastauksista laaditaan yhteenveto, joka julkaistaan Tarjouspalvelu-toimittajaportaalissa 21.11.2026 mennessä. Kysymykset ja vastaukset esitetään suomen kielellä. Kukin tarjoaja on velvollinen tarkistamaan tarjouspyyntöaineiston ja siihen liittyvät lisätiedot Tarjouspalvelu-toimittajaportaalista ennen tarjouksen jättämistä. Muita lisätietoja ei katsota tilaajaa sitoviksi.

title: Germany – Electrical installation work of heating and other electrical building-equipment – Sanierung Baulich-Technische Infrastruktur: Mess- und Regelungstechnik
description: Die Generalverwaltung des Max Planck Institutes in München soll im laufenden Betrieb umfänglich saniert werden. Inhalt der gemäß Leistungsverzeichnis aufgeführten Leistungen ist die Erbringung von Leistungen der Mess- und Regelungstechnik. Dazu gehören der Aufbau von ASP's zur Regelung und Steuerung von Kälte und Heizungsanlagen. Außerdem ist die Einbindung in den Bestand zu realisieren. Da das Gebäude während der gesamten Arbeiten in Nutzung bleibt, sind alle Tätigkeiten daher mit höchster Sorgfalt sowie unter größtmöglichem Schutz des bestehenden Gebäudes und der vorhandenen Anlagen auszuführen. Um dies umzusetzen läuft das Bauvorhaben in mehreren Bauabschnitten ab. Achtung: Diese Ausschreibung beinhaltet Wartungsleistungen. Ausführungsfristen: Mit der Ausführung ist zu beginnen innerhalb von 12 Werktagen nach Zugang der Aufforderung durch den AG (§5Abs. 2 Satz 2 VOB/B). Die Aufforderung wird Ihnen vorauss. bis zum 01.02.2027 zugehen. Die Leistung ist zu vollenden (abnahmereif fertig zu stellen) innerhalb von 1182 Werktagen nach vorstehend angegebener Frist für den Ausführungsbeginn (5 Arbeitstagen/ Woche) sh. hierzu auch Anlage 1 der Besonderen Vertragsbedingungen VHB-214.. Hinweis betr. Bieterfragen aufgrund besonderer äußerer Ereignisse (z.B. Sars-COV-2 oder Ukraine Krieg): Bitte berücksichtigen Sie bei Ihrer Angebotserstellung etwaige mögliche bzw. erkennbare Beeinträchtigungen, z.B. in Bezug auf die Verfügbarkeit von Materialien und Produkten, Arbeitskräften, eine evtl. verzögerte Beibringung von geforderten Nachweisen, Auswirkungen auf etwaige Nachunternehmer etc. Fragen, die in diesem Zusammenhang auftreten, bitten wir rechtzeitig vor Angebotsfrist über das Nachrichtensystem der eVergabe zu stellen.

title: INDUSTRY DAY: LOW-VOLTAGE ELECTRICAL UPGRADES, VA-WIDE
description: INDUSTRY DAY: LOW-VOLTAGE ELECTRICAL UPGRADES OPPORTUNITIES - VA-WIDE The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Office of Acquisition, Logistics, and Construction (OALC), Office of Facilities Acquisition (OFA), Program Contracting Activity Center (PCAC), is hosting an industry day for vendors interested in providing low-voltage electrical services across multiple VA facilities nationwide. The goal is to share information with vendors about the program and for the government to gauge vendor interest, highlight industry concerns, and assist in the set-aside determination, if any, is appropriate for the program. This is an opportunity for industry to influence procurement decisions that will shape the course of the program. Due to the size, scope and complexity of this initiative, the VA is considering interest from all qualified and interested parties to the industry day event. The event will be a meet and greet, review of scope, deliverables, and review of potential solicitation and award methods. PROJECT DESCRIPTION / DESCRIPTION OF WORK / REQUIREMENT The VA has a requirement for an enterprise-wide program to replace designated existing electrical equipment rated 1,000 volts AC nominal or less, including automatic transfer switches (ATS), transformers, switchgear, and switchboards at more than 100 VA Medical Centers across the country during Fiscal Year 2027. This is a pre-scoped, specification-based, like-for-like equipment replacement program. The Contractor shall provide a completely installed and operational replacement while retaining existing distribution arrangements, feeders, raceways, and associated infrastructure. Work is limited to equipment replacement and necessary incidental installation modifications. EVENT The industry day will be held on December 7, 2026, in Cleveland, OH, from 1:00 PM ET to 4:00 PM ET, at the VA Building located at 6100 Oak Tree Blvd, Independence, OH 44131. Specific meeting room location to be sent to registered attendees. Due to limited accommodations, Registration is required to attend this event and will be limited to a total of 65 attendees and no more than 2 attendees from a firm. Registration will be first come first serve. Additional attendance will be accommodated through a virtual team�s link. This notice and event shall not be construed as a solicitation or as an obligation on the part of the Government. title: 13--IL-MIGRATORY BIRD MANAGEMENT-ROCKET NET PROPELLANT
description: Notice of Intent to Sole Source IL-Migratory Bird Management- Rocket Net Propellant The U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, U.S. Department of Interior intends to award a firm-fixed price, sole source to Bae Systems Ordnance Systems Inc. pursuant to Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO) part 12.102(a) for purchases not exceeding the Simplified Acquisition Threshold. This requirement is to provide Rocket Net Propellant under NAICS code 325920 for delivery to Carbondale, IL 62902. The U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Migratory Bird Management (MBM) has been the facilitator of rocket-net charges and propellant for capturing wildlife and monitoring activities since the 1970s. This program plays a vital role in assessing population trends, migration patterns, and the overall health of wildlife resources. Rocket-net charges require military grade, slow burning propellant with specific performance characteristics necessary to safely deploy nets used for wildlife capture. BAE Systems Ordnance Systems, Inc. is the only known domestic manufacturer capable of producing M6 and PAP-7993 propellant that meets the Government's required military specifications, performance standards, and safety requirements for use in the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service rocket-net wildlife monitoring program. Substitution of alternate propellants would require extensive testing and validation to ensure compatibility with existing rocket-net systems and to verify safe operation during wildlife capture activities. Requirements: � At least 1,000 lbs of M6 or PAP-7993 propellant extruded through 175mm Propelling Charge Dimensions Tooling (F/175mm) with formula and tolerances per MIL-STD-652 (U.S. military standard that defines the chemical, physical, and packing requirements for solid cannon propellants in flake, sheet, or cylindrical grain forms) � Propellant will be packaged in standard fiber drums (United Nations and Department of Transportation packaging code 1G) � Propellant Description Sheets (PDS) and Safety Data Sheets for all lots � Final analysis report for quality assurance � Final production and quality control report documenting manufacturing, inspection, and testing results for delivered lots. Salient characteristics include: � Military-grade slow-burning propellant suitable for rocket-net deployment; � Compatibility with existing USFWS rocket-net systems; � Compliance with applicable military specifications and testing standards; � Demonstrated history of safe performance in wildlife capture operations. This notice is not a request for competitive quotations; however, vendors who feel they can meet this requirement may submit a capability statement. Information received will be considered solely for the purpose of determining whether to conduct competitive procurement. All responses and questions should be directed to Khalilah M. Brown via email at khalilah_brown@ios.doi.gov no later than COB, Wednesday, December 2, 2026. Telephone inquiries will not be accepted.

title: SOFAM Non-Tactical Vehicle Rentals
description: The Special Operations Forces Arctic Medic (SOFAM) exercise is a military training event in Fairbanks, Alaska that provides medical training in austere, extreme environments to medics and operators across all military services and federal agencies. Movement of personnel, equipment, and supplies is an essential task in this challenging terrain to effectively support this exercise. The government requires a fleet of high capacity, reliable, commercial Sport Utility Vehicles (SUVs) for transportation of personnel and materiel throughout the training area. SOCNORTH is requesting the delivery of deliver twenty-two (22) Sport Utility Vehicles (SUV), nine (9) trucks, one (1) 15- passenger vans, and one (1) cargo van to facilitate ground transportation for personnel, equipment, and supplies for the duration of the three-week SOFAM exercise in Alaska with a start date of 6 January 2027 and end date of 30 January 2027. Compliance with FAR and DFARS: The contractor shall comply with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) clause 52.228-8, "Liability and Insurance�Leased Motor Vehicles," and Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS) clause 252.247-7007, "Liability and Insurance," as incorporated into this contract. Contractor Liability: The contractor is liable for any loss of or damage to a leased vehicle, except for normal wear and tear, that is caused by the negligence, fault, or wrongful act or omission of the contractor or its employees. The contractor shall indemnify and hold the government harmless against any related claims. Insurance Requirements: The contractor shall maintain the insurance coverage required by FAR 52.228-8 and provide written proof of such coverage to the Contracting Officer prior to contract commencement. Damage Reporting: The contractor shall immediately notify the Contracting Officer of any vehicle damage and provide a written report detailing the incident within one business day GOVERNMENT FURNISHED PROPERTY/EQUIPMENT/INFORMATION: N/A PLACE OF PERFORMANCE: The exercise and training shall be executed on the Fort Wainwright, AK and Yukon Training Area with usage in the greater Fairbanks city limits. PERIOD OF PERFORMANCE: Base: 6-30 January 2027 INSURANCE REQUIREMENTS The Contractor shall provide full vehicle coverage for all rented vehicles for the duration of the contract period. Full vehicle coverage includes collision damage coverage, comprehensive coverage, liability insurance meeting host?nation minimums, and any additional insurance required to ensure the vehicle and all authorized drivers are fully protected against damage, theft, accidents, or third?party claims. The Contractor shall be responsible for all insurance procurement, maintenance, and associated costs. Coverage shall apply without deductible to the Government personnel in performance of their official duties Insurance coverage and information shall be provided at the time of delivery to operating party with copies submitted to Contracting Officer. The contractor shall provide all equipment and associated services with ground transportation vehicle rentals to support SOFAM exercise in Fairbanks, AK from 8 January 2026 to 30 January 2026. The contractor shall perform to the standards specified in the Performance Work Statement (PWS).

title: Direct Write Lithography System
description: Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory is conducting market research to identify sources that possess the capabilities and experience necessary to provide a direct write lithography system. The LBNL Nanofabrication Facility of the Molecular Foundry is a cleanroom lithographic processing facility specializing in the fabrication of devices with nanoscale features across a variety of microelectronic and quantum materials. The facility consists of 4500 square feet of Class 10 clean room space with environmental control of +/-1oF and +/-2% relative humidity. Process capabilities include deposition of thin films, dry plasma etching, wet chemical etching and cleaning operations, photolithography, electron beam lithography, focus ion beam patterning, and wafer metrology through white light microscopy, ellipsometry, and spectroscopy, scanning electron microscopy, and atomic force microscopy. A new optical lithography system is required to improve reliability, flexibility and turnaround time to speed up R&D cycles. Please see the attached RFI document for desired specifications and response instructions.

Installation and facility integration. Complete delivery, rigging, uncrating, placement, anchoring, leveling, calibration, utility connection, and testing. The Government will provide utilities within 20 feet of the HAFTS and will drill anchor-bolt holes to the contractor�s provided specifications. The contractor is responsible for required rigging documentation and lift planning. Testing and acceptance. Origin inspection and testing at the contractor�s facility, followed by final inspection and acceptance testing after installation at FRCSW North Island. The contractor must provide calibrated test resources and demonstrate that the HAFTS can satisfactorily test Government-furnished UUTs in accordance with applicable technical-manual parameters. Technical data and training. Required deliverables include technical data, a Plan of Action and Milestones, preliminary and critical design reviews, Instrument Calibration Procedures Source Data, an Acceptance Test Plan, printed training aids, and test/inspection reports. The contractor must also provide operator and maintenance training at FRCSW. The contractor must achieve and maintain Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) Level 2 or above in accordance with DFARS 252.204-7021 for each contractor information system that will process, store, or transmit Federal Contract Information used in performance of the contract. Contractor personnel requiring on-site access must comply with Naval Base Coronado and FRCSW access procedures, including advance submission of required access forms. The draft SOW also requires Government approval before onsite photography or videography. Respondents capable of meeting this requirement and maintaining the capability throughout the duration of the contemplated effort are encouraged to respond. title: INDUSTRY DAY: LOW-VOLTAGE ELECTRICAL UPGRADES, VA-WIDE
description: INDUSTRY DAY: LOW-VOLTAGE ELECTRICAL UPGRADES OPPORTUNITIES - VA-WIDE The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Office of Acquisition, Logistics, and Construction (OALC), Office of Facilities Acquisition (OFA), Program Contracting Activity Center (PCAC), is hosting an industry day for vendors interested in providing low-voltage electrical services across multiple VA facilities nationwide. The goal is to share information with vendors about the program and for the government to gauge vendor interest, highlight industry concerns, and assist in the set-aside determination, if any, is appropriate for the program. This is an opportunity for industry to influence procurement decisions that will shape the course of the program. Due to the size, scope and complexity of this initiative, the VA is considering interest from all qualified and interested parties to the industry day event. The event will be a meet and greet, review of scope, deliverables, and review of potential solicitation and award methods. PROJECT DESCRIPTION / DESCRIPTION OF WORK / REQUIREMENT The VA has a requirement for an enterprise-wide program to replace designated existing electrical equipment rated 1,000 volts AC nominal or less, including automatic transfer switches (ATS), transformers, switchgear, and switchboards at more than 100 VA Medical Centers across the country during Fiscal Year 2027. This is a pre-scoped, specification-based, like-for-like equipment replacement program. The Contractor shall provide a completely installed and operational replacement while retaining existing distribution arrangements, feeders, raceways, and associated infrastructure. Work is limited to equipment replacement and necessary incidental installation modifications. EVENT The industry day will be held on December 7, 2026, in Cleveland, OH, from 1:00 PM ET to 4:00 PM ET, at the VA Building located at 6100 Oak Tree Blvd, Independence, OH 44131. Specific meeting room location to be sent to registered attendees. Due to limited accommodations, Registration is required to attend this event and will be limited to a total of 65 attendees and no more than 2 attendees from a firm. Registration will be first come first serve. Additional attendance will be accommodated through a virtual team�s link. Registration Instructions for Vendor Day: � Send an email stating your intention to attend the Vendor Day to the contacts listed below. � Provide Company Name, Main Point of Contact, and Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) � Provide the names and positions of no more than 2 within your company of those who plan to attend � Register no later than 5:00 PM ET on December 2, 2026. Send registration and any questions to Jennifer.Braaten@va.gov AND Bailey.Donato@va.gov ADMINISTRATIVE This notice is not a request for competitive offers. Any response to this notice will not be considered a bid or proposal. After completing its analyses, the Government will determine whether to limit competition among small business categories or proceed with full and open competition. This notice and event shall not be construed as a solicitation or as an obligation on the part of the Government. The Government will not provide reimbursement for any expenses incurred in participating in this notice and event. title: RENTAL BUSES (SOFAM)
description: The Special Operations Forces Arctic Medic (SOFAM) exercise is a military training event in Fairbanks, Alaska that provides medical training in austere, extreme environments to medics and operators across all military services and federal agencies. Movement of personnel, equipment, and supplies is an essential task in this challenging terrain to effectively support this exercise. The government requires two buses for transportation of personnel and materiel to the training area. SOCNORTH is seeking to rent two (2) buses with a seating capacity sufficient for at least 30 students with individual equipment for each bus, for a total capacity of 60 students. Buses must be: Equipped with drive mode capabilities for operating on varied terrain and challenging road conditions in Fairbanks, AK, and Yukon Training Area, Eielson Air Force Base. Outfitted with appropriate traction control devices such as chains, winter tires, snow socks) suitable for ice and snow. Equipped with a functioning and robust heating system to ensure passenger comfort and vehicle operational readiness in temperatures well below freezing. Equipped with a secure storage area for student gear (e.g., rucksacks, cold-weather equipment) The contractor shall provide all management, supervision, personnel, equipment, buses, fuel, supplies, and incidental services necessary for the transportation of up to 60 students between the Hotel (TBD- to be determined) and designated training areas on Fort Wainwright, AK. The contractor shall ensure safe, reliable, and punctual service under all local environmental conditions, including challenging terrain and extreme cold weather. The projected schedule is as follows: 22 January 2027: Pick-up location Hotel (TBD) at 1200 traveling to Yukon Training Area, Firebird UAS Building. 24 January 2027: Pick-up location Yukon Training Area, Firebird UAS Building at 1300 pm traveling to the Hotel (TBD). The contractor shall arrive at the designated pick-up location on the specified days at the scheduled time. Arrival more than 10 minutes prior to the scheduled time or any delay beyond the scheduled time must be communicated immediately. The Contractor shall provide full vehicle coverage for all rented vehicles for the duration of the contract period. Full vehicle coverage includes collision damage coverage, comprehensive coverage, liability insurance meeting host?nation minimums, and any additional insurance required to ensure the vehicle and all authorized drivers are fully protected against damage, theft, accidents, or third?party claims. The Contractor shall be responsible for all insurance procurement, maintenance, and associated costs. title: 13--IL-MIGRATORY BIRD MANAGEMENT-ROCKET NET PROPELLANT
description: Notice of Intent to Sole Source IL-Migratory Bird Management- Rocket Net Propellant The U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, U.S. Department of Interior intends to award a firm-fixed price, sole source to Bae Systems Ordnance Systems Inc. pursuant to Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO) part 12.102(a) for purchases not exceeding the Simplified Acquisition Threshold. This requirement is to provide Rocket Net Propellant under NAICS code 325920 for delivery to Carbondale, IL 62902. The U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Migratory Bird Management (MBM) has been the facilitator of rocket-net charges and propellant for capturing wildlife and monitoring activities since the 1970s. This program plays a vital role in assessing population trends, migration patterns, and the overall health of wildlife resources. Rocket-net charges require military grade, slow burning propellant with specific performance characteristics necessary to safely deploy nets used for wildlife capture. BAE Systems Ordnance Systems, Inc. is the only known domestic manufacturer capable of producing M6 and PAP-7993 propellant that meets the Government's required military specifications, performance standards, and safety requirements for use in the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service rocket-net wildlife monitoring program. Substitution of alternate propellants would require extensive testing and validation to ensure compatibility with existing rocket-net systems and to verify safe operation during wildlife capture activities. Requirements: - At least 1,000 lbs of M6 or PAP-7993 propellant extruded through 175mm Propelling Charge Dimensions Tooling (F/175mm) with formula and tolerances per MIL-STD-652 (U.S. military standard that defines the chemical, physical, and packing requirements for solid cannon propellants in flake, sheet, or cylindrical grain forms) - Propellant will be packaged in standard fiber drums (United Nations and Department of Transportation packaging code 1G) - Propellant Description Sheets (PDS) and Safety Data Sheets for all lots - Final analysis report for quality assurance - Final production and quality control report documenting manufacturing, inspection, and testing results for delivered lots. Salient characteristics include: - Military-grade slow-burning propellant suitable for rocket-net deployment; - Compatibility with existing USFWS rocket-net systems; - Compliance with applicable military specifications and testing standards; - Demonstrated history of safe performance in wildlife capture operations. This notice is not a request for competitive quotations; however, vendors who feel they can meet this requirement may submit a capability statement. Information received will be considered solely for the purpose of determining whether to conduct competitive procurement. All responses and questions should be directed to Khalilah M. Brown via email at khalilah_brown@ios.doi.gov no later than COB, Wednesday, December 2, 2026. Telephone inquiries will not be accepted.

The 704th Test Group (704 TG) Aerospace Survivability and Safety Office (OL-AC) at Wright- Patterson AFB, Ohio, requires an advanced, state-of-the-art testing capability to replace its legacy Tire Force Machine (TFM). This is a pre-scoped, specification-based, like-for-like equipment replacement program. The Contractor shall provide a completely installed and operational replacement while retaining existing distribution arrangements, feeders, raceways, and associated infrastructure. Work is limited to equipment replacement and necessary incidental installation modifications. title: 8910 - Dairy Products and Refrigerated Delivery � VA Sierra Nevada Health Care System
description: THIS IS A PRE-SOLICITATION NOTICE Dairy Products and Refrigerated Delivery � VA Sierra Nevada Health Care System PURPOSE The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Regional Procurement Office West (RPOW), Veterans Integrated Service Network (VISN) 5, Health Service Area (HSA) 5.2, Network Contracting Office (NCO) 21, on behalf of VA Sierra Nevada Health Care System (VASNHCS), is conducting market research to identify businesses capable of supplying and delivering fresh dairy products for Veteran patient meal services. DESCRIPTION OF ANTICIPATED REQUIREMENT The contractor would furnish the products, labor, refrigerated transportation, delivery equipment, and associated resources necessary to supply and deliver pasteurized milk and other dairy products to the facility located at 975 Kirman Avenue, Building 1C, Reno, NV 89502 at least twice a week. The requirement is defined by product characteristics, freshness, food safety, and delivery performance, rather than a particular brand, manufacturer, or distributor. The prospective contractor would provide the following descriptions and estimated annual quantities: Item 1: Pasteurized 2% reduced-fat milk; half-gallon container; reference pack 12 containers per case; estimated annual quantity 1,000 containers. Item 2: Pasteurized whole milk; half-pint (8-fluid-ounce) individual container; reference pack 70 containers per case; estimated annual quantity 9,500 containers. Item 3: Pasteurized 1% lowfat milk; half-pint (8-fluid-ounce) individual container; reference pack 70 containers per case; estimated annual quantity 43,000 containers. DELIVERY AND QUALITY EXPECTATIONS Anticipated deliveries are twice weekly, Tuesday and Friday, between 7:00 a.m. and 9:00 a.m. local Reno time, to the address above. Holiday adjustments would be coordinated in advance. Deliveries would include contractor unloading and movement to the designated receiving point in the presence of authorized VA personnel. ANTICIPATED CONTRACT STRUCTURE The Government anticipates an indefinite-delivery, indefinite-quantity (IDIQ) supply contract with firm-fixed unit prices and delivery orders issued as needs arise. A 12-month base ordering period and four 12-month option ordering periods are contemplated, subject to confirmation. Contract dates, minimum guarantee, maximum quantity or value, order limitations, and final award structure have not been established and will be stated in any resulting solicitation. Award is anticipated on or about December 20, 2026 and will be made in accordance with the evaluation criteria stated in the solicitation. The Government anticipates issuing the solicitation on or about 12/15/2026. The solicitation will be available for download from https://sam.gov/content/opportunities. Interested vendors are responsible for monitoring that site for the solicitation and any amendments. This acquisition is subject to the Buy American Act (BAA). The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code for this requirement is 311511, Fluid Milk Manufacturing. The Small Business Administration (SBA) size standard is 1,150 employees. The Product Service Code (PSC) is 8910, Dairy Foods and Eggs. No set-aside determination has been made at this time. The Government is seeking information to support acquisition planning and any applicable socioeconomic determination. REQUESTED CAPABILITY INFORMATION Interested firms should submit a concise capability statement that includes: Company name. UEI and CAGE code. Point of contact name, title, email address, and phone number. Business size under NAICS 311511 and Socioeconomic status, if any. Relevant experience of past performance that demonstrate specific cold-chain logistics, food safety compliance, and reliable delivering/providing dairy products. Identify whether your firm is a manufacturer/processor, distributor, or reseller. Proposed use of subcontractors. Available contract vehicle information, if applicable. Additionally, please answer the following questions (not required): Does your firm intend to submit a bid or quotation if VA issues a solicitation? What lead time is required from award notification to start work and to deliver supplies? What customary commercial practices apply to these supplies and services (explain effects on availability, pricing, and competition)? What additional details would be helpful in submitting your quote? Responses shall be submitted by 12/2/2026 via email to derek.brown7@va.gov. The subject line should include: PRE-SOL RESPONSE � 36C26127Q0182 - Dairy Products and Refrigerated Delivery. This notice is for informational and planning purposes only and shall not be construed as a solicitation or as an obligation on the part of the Government. Responses will be considered by the Government; however, a determination by the Government not to complete the proposed acquisition based upon responses of this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government.

description: Sources Sought Notice Spectrum Engineering Technical Support Services for the Navy and Marine Corps Spectrum Center (NMSC) This Sources Sought Notice (SSN) is in anticipation of a potential future procurement under North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code 541330, Engineering Services. Subject to FAR 15.101, entitled Early Exchanges with Industry, this announcement constitutes an SSN for written information only. This is not a solicitation announcement for proposals, and no contract will be awarded from this announcement. This SSN is not to be construed in any way as a commitment by the U.S. Government, nor will the U.S. Government pay for the information submitted in response. Failure to respond to this SSN does not preclude participation in any future Request for Proposal (RFP) or Request for Quotation (RFQ), should one be issued. In the event a solicitation is released in the future, it will be posted to the Governmentwide Point of Entry at SAM.gov. Potential offerors/quoters are responsible for monitoring the site for updates and additional information regarding this requirement. 1. Description The Naval Supply Systems Command (NAVSUP) Fleet Logistics Center (FLC) Norfolk Contracting Department is seeking information from interested sources capable of providing Spectrum Engineering and Technical Support Services in support of the Navy and Marine Corps Spectrum Center (NMSC). The requirement includes specialized engineering, analytical, software development and sustainment, and administrative support associated with electromagnetic spectrum management, spectrum certification, electromagnetic compatibility, and national security missions. The specific acquisition strategy has not yet been finalized. Interested parties are encouraged to review the attached draft Performance Work Statement (PWS), which outlines the types of tasks the contractor would be required to perform. 2. Requirements The Government is conducting market research to determine the availability and capabilities of potential sources, including small businesses, to perform the requirements described in the attached draft PWS. The anticipated services include, but are not limited to: Spectrum engineering, certification, and electromagnetic compatibility analysis. Satellite spectrum engineering and coordination. Engineering support for commercial broadband installations and spectrum-sharing initiatives. Joint Tactical Information Distribution System (JTIDS), Multifunctional Information Distribution System (MIDS), and Joint Tactical Radio System (JTRS) engineering and coordination. Electromagnetic Compatibility Features (EMCF) certification and validation. Link 16 Pulse Deconfliction Server (LPDS) administration, software development, maintenance, sustainment, and cybersecurity support. Identification Friend or Foe (IFF) engineering, research, development, test, and evaluation support. Spectrum supportability risk assessments, acquisition program support, and national spectrum policy analysis. Specialized administrative and technical coordination support. The Government has determined that these services qualify as commercial services, as defined in FAR 2.101. If solicited, it is anticipated that this requirement will fall under NAICS codes 541330, with a small business size standard of $25.5 million. The anticipated Product/Service Code (PSC) is R425 � Support: Professional � Engineering/Technical. The draft PWS identifies performance primarily within the National Capital Region, including Government facilities at Fort Meade, Maryland, and contractor-provided locations. The requirement also includes travel to other locations as necessary. Personnel performing the requirement must meet the security clearance requirements specified in the draft PWS, including Secret-level eligibility and adjudication at contract start, with certain positions potentially requiring higher-level clearances. The Government has not yet finalized the acquisition vehicle, contract type, or small business set-aside determination, if any. 3. Capability Statements This is a market research tool. The input provided will help the Government ascertain the interest, capability, and capacity of potential contractors. Standard company brochures will not be reviewed. Submission must not exceed five (5) typewritten pages including cover sheet, using no less than a 10-point font size. Responses should be emailed to Dave Vaughn (david.e.vaughn6.civ@us.navy.mil) and Amber Geusic (amber.m.geusic.civ@us.navy.mil) no later than 05:00 PM EST on 02 December 2026. Again, this is not a request for proposal. Technical questions and inquiries may be submitted along with the response; however, the Government is not obligated to answer any questions submitted regarding this SSN. Please note that the information contained in this SSN is for informational purposes only and is subject to change prior to the issuance of any formal solicitation, if one is issued at all. Cover Sheet/Header: Full business name, address, point of contact, telephone number, and email address. Contractor and Government Entity (CAGE) Code. Small Business Category, if any: Small Business, Small Disadvantaged, 8(a), HUBZone, Woman-owned, Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned, or other category. All currently held contracting vehicles under which the vendor can provide the required services (ex. GSA, SEWP, SeaPort-NxG). Capability Statement: Demonstrate the requisite skills, resources, personnel, and technical capabilities necessary to perform ALL requirements of the draft PWS. Documentation of relevant technical expertise and qualifications must be presented in sufficient detail for the Government to determine the respondent�s ability to perform the requirement. If sufficient experience or capability is lacking in a particular area, explain how the respondent would address that limitation through teaming, subcontracting, or other arrangements. Standard brochures and/or paraphrasing of the SSN will not be considered sufficient to demonstrate capability. Address the respondent�s experience with electromagnetic spectrum engineering, spectrum certification, electromagnetic compatibility, and military communications systems, including Link 16 and related technologies. Describe the respondent�s capabilities in software development, sustainment, cybersecurity, and administration of specialized Government information systems, particularly those involving spectrum management or deconfliction. Explain the respondent�s ability to provide appropriately qualified and cleared personnel to meet the technical, administrative, and security requirements of the draft PWS. If providing past performance information, contracts or efforts must be from within the past five (5) years. The discussion must include the applicable contract or task order number and contract vehicle, clearly indicate whether the respondent was a prime contractor or subcontractor under the effort, and provide the final contract price, dates of performance, and project location. Include a brief description of the effort along with a detailed explanation demonstrating its relevance to the requirements in the PWS. 4. Industry Discussions NAVSUP FLC Norfolk Contracting Department representatives may or may not choose to meet with respondents. Any discussions would be solely for the purpose of obtaining further clarification regarding a respondent�s capability to meet the requirements. 5. Questions Questions regarding this announcement shall be submitted directly to Dave Vaughn (david.e.vaughn6.civ@us.navy.mil) and Amber Geusic (amber.m.geusic.civ@us.navy.mil) by 02 December 2026. Verbal questions will not be considered. Interested parties are encouraged to provide feedback on the draft PWS, including identifying any areas that appear vague or require clarification. 6. De jaarlijkse omvang van perceel 1 bestaat uit circa 16.000 are extensief maaien en maaien met afzuigen van bermen, taluds, wadi's en watergangen. Daarnaast circa 110 km extra maaien van bermstroken, 1 meter breed, en het bijmaaien rondom circa 27.900 obstakels. De jaarlijkse omvang van perceel 2 bestaat uit circa 10.000 are extensief maaien en maaien met afzuigen van bermen, taluds en overige groenstroken. Daarnaast circa 85 km extra maaien van bermstroken, 1 meter breed, en het bijmaaien rondom circa 17.800 obstakels.

title: Netherlands – Street-cleaning and sweeping services – Onkruidbestrijding in Ommen
description: Op basis van een dienstverleningsovereenkomst verzorgt ROVA in de gemeente Ommen de onkruidbestrijding op verhardingen in de openbare ruimte. Het doel van de opdracht is om door middel van frequente onkruidbestrijding de verhardingen in de gemeente Ommen zo te onderhouden, waarmee het aanzicht en de verkeersveiligheid worden behouden. De opdracht betreft het beeldgericht beheersen van onkruid op verhardingen binnen de gemeente Ommen overeenkomstig de Kwaliteitscatalogus Openbare Ruimte (KOR). De werkzaamheden omvatten het jaarrond beheersen van onkruid op circa 3650 are elementen- en ongebonden verhardingen en rondom circa 6.000 obstakels. De werkzaamheden worden uitgevoerd op basis van kwaliteitsniveaus A en B.

title: Market Research / Sources Sought � Engineered Cable Support Systems
description: Notice of intent to use a brand name product. The Naval Facilities Engineering Systems Command, Pacific (NAVFAC Pacific) is conducting market research in accordance with FAR Part 10 to identify potential manufacturers capable of producing engineered cable support systems that have equal performance and listing/approval requirements as the E-loop engineered cable support system that is manufactured by Igus. Responses from third-party distributors, pass through resellers, or supply brokers who do not directly own the production line or manufacturing rights to a qualified equivalent product will not be considered responsive to this market survey. FY27 MCON Project P-676 Polaris Point Submarine Pier, located Naval Base Guam requires engineered cable support systems that demonstrate the following salient characteristics: System ensures the seamless transition of electrical and telecom cables from landside to the pier. The pier structure is expected to experience up to 24 inches of displacement during a contingency level earthquake (CLE). Therefore, the electrical and telecom cables must be able to displace, expand, and contract in response to these seismic movements. Typical conduit expansion and deflection fittings allow for only limited movement, accommodating just a few inches of angular and horizontal movement, making them unsuitable for this application. Allows electrical and telecom cables to be sized for plus/minus 36 inches of pier movement, exceeding the expected displacement during a CLE. System will provide strain relief and allow the cables to move during a seismic event without going below the cable's minimum bending radius. Also, the type of cable used remains consistent without compromising its properties, despite concerns about potential damage from seismic activity. This is not a request for proposals, quotes, or an invitation for bid. The intent of this notice is to identify potential alternative engineered cable support systems that will satisfy agency requirements. To be considered, please submit detailed technical data in order for the Government to conduct a comprehensive evaluation of your product to ensure compatibility with the existing system. In accordance with FAR 15.101(c)(2), a response to this notice is not an offer and cannot be accepted by the Government to form a binding contract. The responder is solely responsible for the information it submits and any associated costs. The Government reserves the right to disregard any submittal that is incomplete or vague. Please do not submit company brochures. Please submit complete information via email to Ms. Michelle Gopwani-Lee via electronic mail at michelle.m.gopwani-lee.civ@us.navy.mil no later than 02 December 2026 at 12:30 p.m. H.S.T. Information received after the due date/time will not be considered. Any information provided to the Government in response to this RFI will become U.S. Government property and will not be returned. All proprietary or classified information will be treated appropriately.

title: Netherlands – Supply services of personnel including temporary staff – Europese aanbesteding inhuur extern personeel (brokerdienstverlening)
description: De scope van deze aanbesteding bestaat het leveren van extern personeel op ZZP-basis en overig extern personeel op detacheringsbasis via tweede-ordeleveranciers op basis van een: • Inhuuraanvraag met mededingende voorkeurskandidaat. • Inhuuraanvraag zonder mededingende voorkeurskandidaat. Alle inhuuraanvragen worden op uniforme wijze aangevraagd door Aanbestedende dienst en uitgevoerd door Inschrijver. Iedere inhuuraanvraag bestaat tot en na eventuele aanstelling van de kandidaat minimaal uit de volgende werkzaamheden: • Centraal in behandeling nemen en afhandelen van de inhuuraanvraag; • Al dan niet aanscherpen van de/het aangeleverde functiebeschrijving/functieprofiel; • Toetsen en afstemmen met de Aanbestedende dienst of de inhuuraanvraag op ZZP- of detacheringsbasis kan/moet worden uitgevoerd; • Werving en selectie; • Aanbieden kandidaten; • Bij aanstelling uitvoeren van noodzakelijke verslaglegging en controle op het voldoen aan alle relevante en noodzakelijke wet- en regelgevi De onderhavige opdracht in deze aanbesteding vertegenwoordigt een op basis van historie geraamde opdrachtwaarde van € 425.000,00 exclusief btw/6.578 inhuururen per jaar en aldus € 3.400.000,00 exclusief btw/52.624 inhuururen gedurende de gehele looptijd van de Overeenkomst. Let op: Aanbestedende dienst is voor de raamovereenkomst verplicht een maximale opdrachtwaarde of maximale hoeveelheid op te nemen. Er is echter een onzekerheidsmarge ten aanzien van de afnames, die vooraf niet te kwantificeren is. De Aanbestedende dienst wenst derhalve onderscheid te maken tussen de geraamde opdrachtwaarde (de verwachting) die hierboven is vermeld en de maximale opdrachtwaarde /maximale hoeveelheid van de beoogde raamovereenkomst. De geraamde opdrachtwaarde is indicatief, bedraagt € 3.400.000,00 exclusief btw/52.624 inhuururen en is gebaseerd op een looptijd van acht (8) jaar. De maximale opdrachtwaarde bedraagt € 6.800.000,00 exclusief btw/105.248 inhuururen en is ook gebaseerd op een looptijd van acht (8) jaar. Bij het bepalen van de maximale opdrachtwaarde is rekening gehouden met de eventuele omstandigheid dat de omvang van de leveringen en/of diensten (substantieel) hoger uitvallen dan blijkens de geraamde opdrachtwaarde wordt verwacht. Bij overschrijding van de maximale opdrachtwaarde/hoeveelheid eindigt de Overeenkomst en wordt deze opnieuw aanbesteed. Aan bovenstaande bedragen kunnen geen rechten worden ontleend, hetgeen betekent dat niet met zekerheid kan worden gesteld dat de geraamde en/of maximale opdrachtwaarde daadwerkelijk wordt afgenomen gedurende de looptijd van de Overeenkomst.

Aan bovenstaande bedragen kunnen geen rechten worden ontleend, hetgeen betekent dat niet met zekerheid kan worden gesteld dat de geraamde en/of maximale opdrachtwaarde daadwerkelijk wordt afgenomen gedurende de looptijd van de Overeenkomst.

description: 1. Powyższe ilości mają charakter szacunkowy i służą Wykonawcy pomocniczo do przygotowania oferty oraz prawidłowego skalkulowania kosztów realizacji zamówienia. Zamawiający nie jest zobowiązany do realizacji zamówienia w pełnym szacunkowym wymiarze, a rzeczywista ilość odpadów przekazywanych do odbioru, transportu i zagospodarowania będzie wynikała z bieżących potrzeb Zamawiającego. Zamawiający gwarantuje jednak, że w okresie obowiązywania umowy przekaże Wykonawcy do odbioru, transportu i zagospodarowania co najmniej 4.000 Mg odpadów o kodzie 19 05 03. Wykonawcy nie będą przysługiwały roszczenia z tytułu niezrealizowania przez Zamawiającego zamówienia powyżej gwarantowanej minimalnej ilości 4.000 Mg. 3. Odpad o kodzie 19 05 03 stanowi regularnie wytwarzany materiał o wielkości do 20 mm powstały w procesie przesiewania na sicie mobilnym wyposażonym w bęben o perforacji do 20 mm frakcji odpadów stabilizatu o kodzie 19 05 99 powstałego po procesie biologicznego przetwarzania w instalacjach PGO w Suwałkach Sp. z o. o. frakcji podsitowej <80 mm wydzielonej ze zmieszanych (niesegregowanych) odpadów komunalnych i/lub kompostowania rozdrobnionych bioodpadów (odpady kuchenne i odpady zielone). Odbierane partie odpadów mogą różnić się co do wartości, a jakiekolwiek różnice nie będą stanowiły podstaw roszczeń Wykonawcy w stosunku do Zamawiającego. 4. Dz. U. z 2023 r. poz. 1587, z późn. zm.). 5. Odbiór odpadów następować będzie transportem zorganizowanym przez Wykonawcę i na jego koszt, także w zakresie kosztów przewozu, ubezpieczenia na czas transportu i rozładunku. 6. Odpady o kodzie 19 05 03 magazynowane są luzem na utwardzonym placu i w takiej formie zostaną załadowane na podstawione przez Wykonawcę środki transportu.

title: Germany – Financial leasing services – Rahmenvereinbarung für das Dienstradleasing der Stadt Delmenhorst
description: Die Stadt Delmenhorst möchte eine Rahmenvereinbarung über das Leasing von Fahrrädern für seine ca. 1430 Mitarbeitenden abschließen. Die Stadt Delmenhorst bietet ihren Tarifbeschäftigten bereits seit dem 01.01.2023 die Möglichkeit ein Dienstfahrrad im Wege der Entgeltumwandlung zur dienstlichen sowie privaten Nutzung. Damit das Angebot des Dienstradleasing weiterhin bereitgestellt werden kann, soll im Rahmen einer Folgeausschreibung eine Anbieterin bzw. ein Anbieter (Kooperation aus Service-Dienstleistenden mit Fachhandelnden, Leasinggebenden und Versicherungsdienstleistenden) gefunden werden. Die Stadt Delmenhorst stellt dabei die Leasingnehmerin dar, welche den Beschäftigten und Beamten das Dienstrad zur Verfügung stellt. Eine Rahmenvereinbarung soll dabei den Leasinginhalt darstellen, die die Bereitstellung von Fahrrädern im Wege des Leasings (Teilamortisationsleasing) zum Zwecke der Überlassung an die Beschäftigten und Beamten zur dienstlichen und privaten Nutzung einschließlich Versicherungs-, Schulungs- und Serviceleistungen, insbesondere die Abwicklung der Bestell-, Rückgabe- und Schadenabwicklungsprozesse, Wartung und Reparatur, Störfallmanagement und Bereitstellung eines Online-Portals beinhalten. Die Rahmenvereinbarung schließt die Auftraggeberin mit der Auftragnehmerin bzw. dem Auftragnehmer. Die im Rahmen eines Angebots gemachten finanziellen Konditionen, insbesondere die Leasingrate inkl. Versicherung sowie (teils optionalem) Service- und Versicherungspaket, werden für die Laufzeit der Rahmenvereinbarung fest und verbindlich vereinbart. Die Auftraggeberin schließt auf Grundlage der Rahmenvereinbarung Einzelleasingverträge für die Beschäftigten und Beamten mit der Auftragnehmerin bzw. dem Auftragnehmer ab. Entsprechende Nutzungs- und Überlassungsverträge mit den Rechten und Pflichten der Beschäftigten sowie Beamten werden zwischen diesen und der Auftragnehmerin bzw. dem Auftragnehmer vereinbart. Die Nutzungs- und Überlassungsverträge regeln zudem die Entgeltumwandlung. Die Auftragnehmerin bzw. der Auftragnehmer koordiniert nach Maßgabe der Leistungsbeschreibung die Gesamtleistung und wickelt diese einheitlich ab.

title: Germany – Building construction work – Totalunternehmer / Totalübernehmer Arnoldschule, Arnoldstr. 31
description: Die Stadt Bochum (nachfolgend "Auftraggeber") steht als Schulträger vor der Herausforderung, dem stetig wachsenden Raumbedarf aufgrund der steigenden Schulanmeldungen im Bochumer Stadtgebiet zu entsprechen. In diesem Zusammenhang herrscht - neben dem Erfordernis an Sanierungs- und Erhaltungsmaßnahmen bereits bestehender Schulgebäude - ein erheblicher Bedarf an der Schaffung neuer Sport- und Lernräume. Dabei ist der Auftraggeber nach dem Schulgesetz verpflichtet, Schulentwicklungsplanung zu betreiben. Zur Erfüllung dieser ihr gesetzlich obliegenden Pflicht plant der Auftraggeber dem wachsenden Raumbedarf im Rahmen eines umfassenden Schulbau- und Schulmodernisierungsprogramms zu begegnen. Dieses beinhaltet erforderliche Neubau-, Umbau- und Sanierungsmaßnahmen für 27 schulische Einrichtungen. Das Programm umfasst dabei alle Schularten und bezieht sich auf Grund-, Förder- und weiterführende Schulen. Eingebettet in dieses Schulbauprogramm soll nun die Erweiterung und der Umbau der Arnoldschule, Arnoldstr. 31, 44793 Bochum erfolgen. Die bauliche Erweiterung sowie der Umbau der Arnoldschule soll durch einen Totalunternehmer / Totalübernehmer erfolgen. Die Arnoldschule liegt in einem dicht bebauten innerstädtischen Wohngebiet im Stadtteil Griesenbruch. Das Schulgrundstück umfasst ca. 7.643 m². Nördlich des Grundstücks liegt jenseits der Arnoldstraße eine öffentliche Grünanlage. Der Hauptzugang erfolgt von Norden über eine fußläufige Verbindung zwischen Adolfstraße und Heuverstraße. In der Praxis wird der südliche Eingang zum Innenhof über die Henriettenstraße genutzt. Die Feuerwehrzufahrt erfolgt westlich über die Heuverstraße auf den Schulhof. Die Schule setzt sich aus drei Baukörpern zusammen: dem Schulgebäude mit Untergeschoss, Erdgeschoss und einem Obergeschoss im nördlichen Grundstücksbereich (ca. 864 m²), einem südlichen Gebäude mit zwei Betreuungsräumen der OGS (ca. 153 m²) sowie der Sporthalle im Südwesten (ca. 720 m²). Die Schulhoffläche beträgt ca. 2.680 m². Die Bestandsräume reichen für den prognostizierten Bedarf an Unterrichts- und Ganztagsflächen nicht aus. Die geplante Maßnahme soll in fünf Schritten realisiert werden: Schritt 1: Umnutzung Computerraum zu einem Klassenraum - bereits erfolgt; Ein Computerraum, der nicht mehr benötigt wurde, wurde bereits zu einem Klassenraum umgenutzt. Schritt 2: Containeranlage als zusätzlicher Klassenraum - bereits erfolgt; Es wurde bereits ein Container nördlich der Turnhalle aufgestellt und bietet Platz für einen weiteren Klassenraum. Schritt 3: Neubau; Zunächst wird der bestehende Spielplatz zurückgebaut. Im Anschluss kann der Neubau in Form eines Gebäuderiegels entlang der Adolfstraße am Standort des alten Spielplatzes erfolgen. Um den Schülerinnen und Schülern einen alternativen Pausenbereich zur Verfügung zu stellen, soll ein Zugang über die Henriettenstraße zum benachbarten Bolzplatz hergestellt werden. Schritt 4: Abbau des Containers und Herstellung des Spielplatzes; Im nächsten Schritt wird der Container durch den TU/TÜ abgebaut und der endgültige Spielplatz nördlich der Sporthalle hergestellt. Schritt 5: Umbau; Die erforderlichen Umbaumaßnahmen im Bestandsgebäude können parallel zu Schritt 4 durchgeführt werden. Gegenstand der vorliegenden Ausschreibung ist die vollständige Erbringung sämtlicher Planungs-, Bau-, Ausstattungs- und Inbetriebnahmeleistungen sowie die Übernahme des gesamten Schnittstellenrisikos. Die vollständige funktionale Leistungsbeschreibung wird mit Aufforderung zur Angebotsabgabe zur Verfügung gestellt. Aus dieser werden die planerischen Schnittstellen zwischen den verschiedenen Disziplinen, Gewerken und Fachbereichen zu entnehmen sein. Mit dieser EU-weiten Bekanntmachung wird der Teilnahmewettbewerb eingeleitet. Weitere Informationen sind den auf der Vergabeplattform zur Verfügung gestellten Vergabeunterlagen zu entnehmen.

In dem viergeschossigem Gebäude ist die Hälfte der Fläche für Labore, Mess- und Wägeräume vorgesehen, die sich im nördlichen Gebäudeteil befinden. Weitere Nutzflächen sind Büroflächen sowie Seminarräume und Hörsäle. Ein Foyer, das die Geschossebenen über einen Luftraum miteinander verbindet, dient als Haupterschließung. Im Erdgeschoss erweitern studentische Arbeitsplätze das Foyer und ermöglichen einen Zugang zum begrünten Innenhof. Die Technikzentrale erstreckt sich als fünftes Geschoss über die Hälfe der Gebäudefläche.
